meta.name: offensive-wifi-recon
meta.description: Wi-Fi reconnaissance methodology — adapter selection, monitor mode and packet injection setup, regulatory domain handling, multi-band airspace mapping, hidden SSID discovery, BSSID/ESSID/channel/PMF/encryption fingerprinting, client probe analysis, vendor OUI lookup, war-driving with Kismet/airodump-ng/Wigle, and structured airspace data capture for downstream attacks. Use at the start of any wireless engagement to build the target map before active attacks; covers 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz (Wi-Fi 6E) bands and adapter compatibility for each.

copy.tagline: 扫描周边 Wi-Fi，摸清隐藏网络与安全特征
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要在无线渗透测试前先绘制周边网络地图
copy.tagline_en: Scan nearby Wi-Fi networks and profile their security before an engagement
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to map the Wi-Fi airspace before wireless penetration testing.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按无线侦察流程引导你：选网卡、开监听模式、设监管域、扫描 2.4/5/6GHz 频段、找隐藏 SSID，并提取 BSSID、信道、加密等信息，整理成目标清单供后续测试。
howto.when: 在任何无线测试开始前，需要先摸清周边 Wi-Fi 环境、建立目标地图时触发；例如要求扫描附近网络、寻找隐藏 SSID 或准备攻击时。

say.text: 帮我扫描周围 Wi-Fi，列出 BSSID 和加密方式。
say.note: 触发全频段扫描并整理目标清单。

say.text: 怎么发现隐藏的 Wi-Fi 名称？
say.note: 引导你用客户端探测或授权后去认证。

say.text: 用 Kismet 记录附近所有无线网络。
say.note: 启动战争驾驶，生成地图数据。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through Wi-Fi recon: choosing an adapter, enabling monitor mode, setting the regulatory domain, sweeping 2.4/5/6GHz bands, finding hidden SSIDs, and extracting BSSID, channel, encryption, etc. into a structured target list for later testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of any wireless engagement, before active attacks, to build a target map. For example, when you ask to scan nearby networks, find hidden SSIDs, or prepare for an attack.

say_en.text: Scan nearby Wi-Fi and list BSSIDs and encryption.
say_en.note: Triggers a full-band sweep and target summary.

say_en.text: How can I discover hidden Wi-Fi names?
say_en.note: Guides you to use client probes or deauth if authorized.

say_en.text: Use Kismet to log all nearby wireless networks.
say_en.note: Starts war-driving capture and map data.
